summary: The /lenders/ page could not be surfaced directly: search (a) on the exact URL returned the homepage, /commercial-mortgage-broker/, /property-development-finance/, /about-us/, LinkedIn, Instagram and a Letting Agent Today directory listing but stated 'I couldn't find the exact page at that URL in the results'; search (b) (site: + lenders panel commission unrestricted) returned other site pages and the Ts&Cs PDF; search (c) returned only unrelated US 'Silver Oak' wealth-management firms. The only content specific to /lenders/ comes from the seed first-pass snippet: the firm 'generally focuses on transactions upwards of £500,000', 'works with an unrestricted number of lenders' and 'typically receives commission from lenders, with details disclosed during the process'. Indirect material gathered: lender-count claims that vary by page (300+, 500+, 700+, 800+), lender-type lists (private banks, investment banks, specialist lenders, private debt funds, debt funds), the Ts&Cs statement that the firm offers products from across the market but not deals obtainable only by going direct to a lender, and introducer-page wording on commissions, discretion, transparency and strict non-circumvention.

sections.heading: Transaction focus [seed /lenders/]
sections.content: The firm 'generally focuses on transactions upwards of £500,000'. Consistent with the homepage claim 'over £500,000' [seed loanSizeClaims] and the about page '£500K to £20m' [seed].

sections.heading: Lender relationships / scope of market [seed /lenders/, b]
sections.content: Works with 'an unrestricted number of lenders' [seed /lenders/]. The Ts&Cs document (2026/02) says the firm 'offers products from across the market, but not deals that you can only obtain by going direct to a lender' [b]. Another site page says the firm draws on 'deep relationships with banks, specialist lenders, debt funds and private banks' [b] (source page not identified by the search summary).

sections.heading: Remuneration / commission disclosure [seed /lenders/, b]
sections.content: The firm 'typically receives commission from lenders, with details disclosed during the process' [seed /lenders/]. The introducers page describes a network that lets partners 'earn commissions through trusted referrals and flexible lending solutions' and says the process rests on 'discretion, transparency, and strict non-circumvention' [b]; the search summary noted it 'does not say whether commission is capped or restricted' and that the snippet was truncated with no fee schedule.

sections.heading: Size of lender network (contradictory across pages) [a, seed]
sections.content: Homepage: 'arranges debt on loans through our network of over 800 lenders' [a]. About page: '800+ Lenders' [a]. Commercial mortgage broker page: '700+ Lenders' [a]. Property development finance page: '300+ Lenders' [a]. LinkedIn: '500+ different private banks, investment banks, specialist lenders & private debt funds' [a]. Letting Agent Today directory (older): 'through our network of over 300 lenders' [a]. The search tool's own remark: 'The inconsistency suggests the count has changed over time, so the current figure is best confirmed directly with the firm.' [a]. Seed attributes 800+ to home, /faq/, Trustpilot and Property Week; search (a) additionally attributes 800+ to the about page.

sections.heading: Panel valuers (valuation context, not commission) [b]
sections.content: Several site pages (post-planning land, conversions) mention lenders 'whose panel valuers' understand a particular value basis such as residual land value or local conversion demand [b]. The jewellery loans page says 'lenders typically commission an independent valuer' [b] - the word 'commission' here refers to valuations, not broker fees.
